provenance.qualification: Objective diagnostic only. All baseline/final approaches fail; no positive design target admission.

brief: 研究者迁移任务：两人居住，需要较连续的起居活动空间，同时保留已有储物以及睡眠、用餐、厨房、卫浴和窗前接近。可重新布置三件柜体，其余对象不能改动；不得删除或缩放柜体。房间与尺寸为研究者假设，具体方案自行选择。

source_context.supported: Architect concentrates storage and technical needs into a long multifunctional wall. This trial represents only peripheral grouping of existing external storage envelopes.

question: 比较前后集中储物方案的客观收益、代价与未知项。指出具体对象、活动与证据；是否足以给出整体专业偏好？
assumptions: 6x5x2.6m shell, northwest bathroom, one window and initial furniture placements are researcher assumptions, not the source surveyed plan or historical before-state.
Source describes an integrated built-in technical/storage wall. Three separate .8x.4x2.2m movable proxy cabinets express only peripheral concentration of external envelopes.
Original four-window lighting, construction/services integration, storage capacity, door opening, material/design quality and physical handling are unverified.
Bed/kitchen/bathroom/chairs/lighting are declared proxies; sofa/table are fixed cached mesh substitutes. Same generic structural template as AIR is shared, never an independent test split.
2cm grid, square bodies .4/.5/.6m at1.8m height and fully open proxy door leaves are conditional geometric scenarios, not comfort or accessibility standards.

fixed_access.door_assumption: Both proxy door leaves omitted as hypothetically fully open; hinge/sweep unverified.
limits: Full-height AABB footprints are conservative, including gaps within furniture.
2 cm discretization and square body scenarios; not a human or accessibility model.
A failed conservative route is a warning, not proof no human route exists.
A successful route does not verify sitting, opening storage, reaching, turning or comfort.

floor_rectangle.scope: Empty axis-aligned floor rectangle under conservative AABBs and assumed clear height, anywhere in room; not an activity pass or reachable human area.

living_region.scope: Researcher-defined living-floor region; not source area ratio, light, comfort or activity success.

storage.front_definition: Researcher-declared local +Y, five sampled points per unit/body width. Static boxes have no doors, shelves or usable storage model.

claims.activity: 连续起居活动与储物接近
claims.assessment: 声明起居区空地增加0.880000平方米，但0.4/0.5/0.6米代理下前后固定活动点均为0/7，柜前点均为0/15可达。入口格本身为空，连通范围很小，不能用零到零的无损失宣称用途保留。

claims.activity: 保留储物对象并重新安排
claims.assessment: 26对象保留，23非目标对象不变；三柜未缩放或删除。保持外包络并不能证明容量、柜门操作、技术设备或施工功能。

claims.activity: 从入口进入用餐与其他活动区域
claims.assessment: 未移动的西餐椅、餐桌、厨房台包络在三种代理宽度膨胀后连接，构成入口瓶颈的一部分。它属于既有重建初态缺陷；不能把局部空地收益当成房间可用，也不能据此否定源项目的设计原则。

unknowns: 无独立设计师对重建候选的偏好评价。
原项目的整合技术墙、四窗采光、可用容量、物理搬运与人体使用未验证。
研究模板共享，不能作为新独立测试或模型学习收益。
